ctx.x: "Every Day". But I had been with Errol Garner then. I made Errol Garner's "Misty" (inaudible). I was working there. Oh, in the '50's, I was working with Errol. Hazel Scott, '53, '53 I was with Errol GARNER.
How long were you with him?
